## buddy-sbx run task

Submit an autonomous task for execution in a workspace

### Synopsis

Task dispatches an autonomous coding task against a workspace, running through the agent harness and verification gates.

```
buddy-sbx run task [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  # Submit a task against a workspace
  buddy-sbx run task --workspace repo-auth --prompt "Fix race condition in auth.go"

  # Submit a task with a specific agent profile and branch
  buddy-sbx run task --workspace repo-auth --prompt "Add unit tests" --profile profile-golang --branch fix/auth-tests
```

### Options

```
  -b, --branch string            Target Git branch
  -h, --help[=true|false]        help for task
      --idempotency-key string   Client idempotency key (defaults to generated timestamp)
      --max-attempts int         Maximum retry attempts (default 1)
      --profile string           Agent profile ID
  -p, --prompt string            Autonomous task prompt/instructions (required)
  -w, --workspace string         Workspace name (required)
```
